annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it actively promotes BitClub Network by promising daily Bitcoin earnings and encouraging viewers to recruit other people whose payments would generate payments for the promoter. The recruitment-dependent structure is presented as an easy-income opportunity, including the claim that viewers can earn daily for 1,000 days and even with little or no list.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the speaker describes bringing in other people, a group of up to 100 miners, and receiving Bitcoin whenever those participants are paid. The promised earnings therefore depend on a multi-person recruitment relationship rather than solely on the speaker's own mining activity.
